entities.summary: Charles Jean-Pierre Lallemand (1857-1938) was a French geophysicist. He was elected a member of the French Academy of Sciences in 1910. He was the first president of the International Union of Geodesy and Geophysics He was also president of the Société astronomique de France, from 1923 to 1925.
